fact: ANATS and the OIF discussed interoperability between communal civil-status services and the SIGPTS, and ANATS reaffirmed its commitment to support N'Djamena's digital transition (Tribune Echos).
system: Système Intégré de Gestion des Personnes et des Titres Sécurisés (SIGPTS)

fact: Le N'Djam Post reports that ANATS, the secure-titles agency, officially launched digitisation of civil-registration on 2025-09-16, its mission being to identify every birth systematically and issue civil status acts.
The N'Djamena civil registry digitization MoU with ANATS plans to connect municipal civil-registration systems with the national identification system (SIGPTS), reported by We are Tech.
The ANATS director general says household enrolment teams in a six-month, twelve-province birth registration operation will collect data to be integrated into the national biometric register.
An ATPE opinion piece says TASDJIL registers births at a hospital desk at Koukou Angarana and issues the child an NNI, so births feed the ID number.
